strategy.title: No plan: the only opening needs 60 owner hours against a 13-hour ceiling
strategy.why: The single opening (certified translation, $400/deal, 10 written acceptances = $4,000) is fulfilled by the owner personally at 6 hours per deal. Ten deals need 60 owner hours; the objective allows ~3 h/week = 13 hours in 30 days, which covers 2 deals ($800). No other fulfiller is recorded, so the target cannot be carried inside the owner-hours limit.
